title: Axial single-pile geotechnical capacity

sourceFiles.coverage: Migrates the one-dimensional GroundProfile path required by axial pile capacity. GroundSection2D and PorePressureField2D remain deferred.
Migrates material- and layer-based parameter selection for GroundProfile analyses. Zone and deformation paths remain deferred.
Places the inherited method-specific capacity equations in the norms layer while preserving their public root export.

outsideCorpus: USACE EM 1110-2-2906 (1991), paragraphs 4-3a(1)-(4), equations for axial pile capacity

independentValidation.method: live full-result and DTO comparison with the pinned JavaScript source
parityFixtures: layered drained pile with hydrostatic groundwater
undrained compression with alpha shaft and Nc base resistance
pile, scenario, ground, and design-situation DTO normalization

parityDifferences: The TypeScript result adds metadata.normativeReferences with an explicit outside-corpus USACE record; removing that additive field yields exact full-result parity for every migrated fixture.

The public GroundModel and GeotechnicalDesignSituation exports are partial in this slice: their one-dimensional GroundProfile behavior is migrated, while two-dimensional zones, pore-pressure fields, and deformation-parameter resolution remain deferred.
engineeringFunctionality: Usable method-neutral static ULS axial capacity for one vertical constant-section pile in a layered one-dimensional GroundProfile. It integrates alpha-undrained, beta effective-stress, or assigned shaft resistance and undrained-Nc, effective-stress-Nq, or assigned base resistance. Any design-resistance conversion must be explicitly supplied with provenance. Pile groups, pile-cap load sharing, axial transfer curves, settlement, negative skin friction, cyclic and seismic effects, lateral response, and structural section verification are not implemented by this slice.
